payload.text: ISSUE:0680 after WP-09 (vc's ruling 2026-11-11, size S, cause measured by cc: a wrapper that unsets CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR reads $HOME/.claude, absent here, and caller() says NoSession; torn reads measured false). Build red then green: (1) slots::caller and slots::session_live tell four cases apart, each with its own remedy: sessions directory absent (the path read, and whether CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR chose it), directory unlistable, the session's file unreadable (path and why), no file naming the session; no retry. (2) The desk shows a start with no end whose asker is alive. Release-from-start.json is dropped.
